WAVE_1_RESULT.central_finding: CLAIM 032 — 'WWOX haploinsufficiency is not deleterious', clinical relevance VERY HIGH, in observation — sources its mammary leg to PAPER 053, the Aldaz 2014 review, whose sentence 'loss of a single Wwox allele did not have any observable phenotypic effect in the mammary gland' IS PMID 22574198, the review's ref 55. full_text_queue_current.md FT-103 had already stated at priority ALTA that the boundary BATCH_20260914_005 wrote on that sentence rests on a section-21d consultation and no receipt in this repository. It now has one, read blind. The boundary is CONFIRMED: the branching morphometry compares Cre-negative WT, Cre-positive WT and KO only, with no heterozygote group. Two things are added. First, the review's other quoted sentence, 'the lifespan of the Wwox heterozygotes was indistinguishable from WT mice', is NOT attributable to ref 55: its heterozygotes are BK5-Cre-driven and tissue-restricted, not germline, and the survival curve is plotted only to about day 118, so no lifespan measurement for them exists in the paper. Second, Cre expression alone accounts for about 45 percent of the branching loss (Cre-negative WT 5.45, Cre-positive WT 4.05, KO 2.35 branches per mm), and the MMTV controls pool Cre-positive with Cre-negative animals — so any use of the branching phenotype in either direction must carry that. Separately, the same paper carries an open lead nobody has followed: all 22 BK5-Cre Wwox fl/fl mice die between day 68 and day 117 with the cause undetermined, in a paper that examines no nervous-system tissue at all (brain, neur, seizure, CNS, behav: zero hits).
arithmetic_reproduced: Ferguson 2012's stated mean lifespan of 115 days for BK5 knockouts is arithmetically impossible: with one death at day 68 and none after day 117, the maximum possible mean for n = 22 is 114.8, and the curve's median is about 100.
Ferguson 2012 Table S1 exceeds its own declared cutoff: the Stat3 probe carries p = 0.0102, and 19 of 913 probes have p > 0.01.

Ferguson 2013: SMAD3 ranks 7th in the authors' own ChEA supplement (E2F4, SOX2 human, MYC mouse 71.85, E2F1 human, SOX2 mouse, E2F1 mouse, then SMAD3 54.78, tied with SMAD2 from the same ChIP-X study). Figure 2C shows the top four HUMAN entries, an undeclared filter.
Ferguson 2013: the supplement's own mean fold changes are FST 5.19, PTHLH 3.66, ANGPTL4 3.55, SERPINE1 2.54, against qPCR folds of about 4.5 for ANGPTL4 and about 11 for PTHLH.

Park 2004: Figure 4 displays 17 lanes, not 18, with Chang absent; the sentence '72% (13 out of 18) lower than 90% that of normal' counts the 13 bars below 0.10, so it means MORE than 90 percent lower, on a denominator of 17. 13/17 = 76.5%, against the 72% and 75% printed in two places.
Park 2004: the insert is called 96 bp, but coordinates 5281331-5281425 span 95 nucleotides inclusive.

Stewart 2014: counting the vector drawing commands of Figure 1's WWOX panel gives 17 markers per series (pre: 0 x6, 10, 30, 30, 50, 80, 100 x5, 130, median 30; post: 0 x5, 30, 40, 80, 100 x5, 130, 200, 200, 220, median 100), which reconciles the stated medians of 30 and 100 and the '3 of 6' conversions that 16 markers cannot.
Stewart 2014: Table 2 prints the WWOX P as 0.05 where the text and figure give 0.0547.

WAVE_1_RESULT.self_caught_defect: Two, both invisible to every check in this repository. FIRST: my visual count of Figure 1's WWOX panel in Stewart 2014 gave 16 markers, which cannot reconcile the paper's stated pre-treatment median of 30 with its six zero scores and its '3 of 6' conversions. Page 4 of that PDF holds 175 drawing objects and no image — the chart is vector art, and the PMC CDN blob is a lossy rendering of it, not the source. Counting the drawing commands gives 17 per series, with two markers coincident; 17 reconciles the medians, the zeros and the fraction. No resolution of a raster recovers two markers at the same coordinate. SECOND: the four receipts were first stamped 19:58Z while the actual time was 19:53; they were restamped to the real 19:54:00Z and re-validated. No validator compares a receipt's timestamp to the clock, so a fabricated attestation time would have entered the record unchallenged. Both are in the session evaluation's ATTRIBUTION_CENSUS as the two severity-high incidents, both self-caught.
